selection: One ReferencePrecisionHuber / reference-precision-huber candidate fixed before implementation/build/new fitting.
motivation: 146U full room audit found variants only 2.008mm/0.0602deg apart against 0.379m/12.8deg reference error; fixed bin 170..339 contributes 37.18% of 1s translation SSE. A robust-objective trial is motivated, without inferring a cause or selecting frames.

fitting_model.preprocessing_selector: raw only; reject every other preprocessing combination
fitting_model.storage: Owned f64 Level buffers explicitly holding f32-quantized fitting values; no f32 memory-saving claim
fitting_model.input: u8 gray divided by 255 in f32; metric f32 depth promoted to f64; original inclusive finite depth admission and NaN holes
fitting_model.separable_operator: Replicate edges. Each horizontal tap product is f32; accumulate the three products in order in f64 and store f32. Each vertical product is f32; accumulate in order in f64 and store f32. Recompute horizontal samples locally to avoid an additional full-plane intermediate. All taps participate, including zero times NaN.
fitting_model.initial_filter: Gaussian3 weights [0.25,0.5,0.25] on gray and depth using the separable operator; NaNs propagate
fitting_model.normalization: Once, initial rounded correspondences in row-major order; f64 means/gains, gain=0.5/mean; require minimum count and finite positive means/gains before mutation; each multiplied gray value stored as f32 without clipping
fitting_model.pyramid: Floor width/2,height/2, each scheduled level >=3x3; gray separable Gaussian3 then left-associated f32 (a+b+c+d)/4; depth same f32 mean without Gaussian; nonfinite propagates; halve fx,fy,cx,cy
fitting_model.matching: Retain native f64 source unproject ((x-cx)*z/fx,(y-cy)*z/fy,z), proper pose transform and projection. trunc(projected+0.5), finite signed bounds before usize, finite selected target depth and original metric difference gate. No target uniqueness or bitwise external correspondence equivalence claim.
fitting_model.fitting_point: Separate source XYZ: ((x-cx)*z*(1/fx)), ((y-cy)*z*(1/fy)), z each cast f32 then promoted f64; proper pose transform in f64. Skip a fitting row if this transformed point is not finite with positive z.
fitting_model.gradients: Sobel separable horizontal [-1,0,1],vertical [1,2,1] for x and swapped for y; f32 operator output promoted f64 then multiplied by 1/8. Each nonfinite depth derivative becomes zero. Local surrogate, not an exact derivative of rounded lookup.
fitting_model.residuals: Photometric target-source subtraction in f32 promoted f64. Depth target f32 promoted f64 minus transformed quantized point.z in f64.
fitting_model.normal_equations: Existing f64 residual Jacobians with scalar Huber scales above, applied to both J and residual; unit-weight Normal accumulation, deterministic 16-row tile order. Existing finite checked pivoted Gaussian solve.
fitting_model.solve: Existing finite-checked pivoted f64 Gaussian solver; singular/nonfinite failure remains failure
fitting_model.pose_update: Proper left Rz(delta_z)*Ry(delta_y)*Rx(delta_x), t_new=R_step*t_old+delta_translation; finite proper AbsolutePose admission
fitting_model.iterations: All original 20,10,5 scheduled updates; no epsilon early exit
fitting_model.final_admission: Original full-resolution raw bilinear final statistics, count/fraction/depth/error gates; no filtered final admission
fitting_model.ownership: Safe borrowed Rust input; Python owns four image copies before GIL release; CPU only, explicit device transfers unchanged
fitting_model.working_bytes: 32*sum(floor-pyramid pixels)+64*base_pixels+max(ceil(height/16)*sizeof(Normal),48*sizeof(f64)); checked arithmetic/options before allocation; excludes caller/Python inputs, allocator metadata and stacks
fitting_model.workers: At most four private CPU workers, deterministic ordered tiles; WASM serial

robust_loss.name: independent scalar Huber IRLS
robust_loss.units: gray normalized to pair mean 0.5; metric depth metres; fixed engineering prior, not measured sensor noise
robust_loss.factor: 1 at zero or abs(r)<=delta, otherwise delta/abs(r)
robust_loss.scale: sqrt(original scalar photo/depth weight) * sqrt(Huber factor), in that order in f64
robust_loss.admission: Derived depth delta must be finite strictly positive before allocation. Invalid residual/delta or factor underflow to zero propagates NaN to existing finite checks; no silent zero/clamp or row deletion.
robust_loss.statistics: Retain original unweighted fitting SSE/counts and original unweighted raw bilinear final statistics; never replace support/admission with clipped errors.

legacy: Preserve all six old choices/defaults/reports, and byte-identical old rounded_sobel.rs/reference_precision.rs. Add only a non-exhaustive typed model and explicit Python selector; no mandatory new options fields.
real_protocol: All four are already observed development data. Reuse all original PNG/index payloads by hard link with exact source/calibration/controls. One common fixed policy across xyz/rpy/plant/room; identity then preceding returned relative increment, all original 35 updates and raw/final/world/full-cloud/typed IO/score gates. Freeze all four complete trajectories before any score. No parameter sweep, per-scene candidate switching, reference in fitting, retry, reset, trim, rescale or post-score model change.

synthetic.oracle: Independent NumPy source-modeled reference pipeline/XYZ/J with scalar Huber factors, f64 equations and proper left Euler update; solve separately with numpy.linalg.solve. No new external reference fit or general bitwise-equivalence claim.

resources.preservation: Hash-protect all 439 prior scientific JSON, all completed 146U outputs and 39 old native artifacts including the frozen shared GPU example. Complete fail-closed inventories; preserve failures. Reclaim only exact completed passing pytest basetemps after XML/absolute/no-reparse checks.

verification: Independent Huber loss derivative/weight/scale/zero/extreme/nonfinite and normal-system math, exact budget/underflow/odd/hole/causal/proper/serial-parallel tests; 30 cases across six legacy choices with frozen prior extension; native/Python/Clippy/WASM/stub/installed-wheel checks before real fitting; separately freeze new source/wheel/extension/native test exe. No new unsafe, production dependencies or hidden transfers.
remaining_80_percent: Both raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; canonical complete mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance; independent genuinely unobserved motion robustness. No percentage promotion from synthetic agreement or CI alone.
